title: Accept attachment capture only with scoped local-durability evidence

requirements.invariant: A success-shaped local capture receipt binds one stable Attachment ID to exact Account and parent scope plus the byte count and checksum of bytes an adapter reports as durably saved; it is independent of URL/path identity and cannot be created from mismatched capture and persistence evidence.

Attachment bytes awaiting verified upload remain local byte authority and never enter Codable structured receipt/sync evidence; only stable identity, exact scope, byte count, checksum, opaque local-object identity and audit time cross this boundary.

Capture and persistence evidence remain bound to the same environment, Principal and Account across canonical restart; cross-environment, cross-Principal or cross-Account evidence is rejected rather than rebound to the active session.

A backend-neutral capture port accepts raw local capture input and returns a durable receipt or throws; it exposes no Storage upload primitive and no reference-removal or physical-byte-deletion operation while O-023 remains open.

Deterministic contract tests may prove the receipt and port boundary, restart encoding and fail-closed result shape, but cannot promote the slice to physical local-durability evidence; encrypted filesystem, process/device restart and interruption proof remain required of the later provider adapter and spike.

This Phase 1 attachment contract is executable in the isolated provider-free target package while the Firebase app remains unchanged and no local filesystem adapter, Supabase Storage, PowerSync, schema, migration, hosted resource or production authority is introduced.

items: LocalAttachmentCapture owns preallocated stable AttachmentID, exact environment/Principal/Account/parent scope, capture time and nonempty raw bytes; raw bytes are Sendable input but never Codable structured evidence.

AttachmentContentSHA256 and AttachmentLocalObjectID are distinct validated values; AttachmentPersistedLocalObjectEvidence records only exact scope, opaque local-object identity, positive byte count, digest and finite persistence time.

AttachmentLocalDurabilityReceipt is constructed only by matching capture and persisted evidence, carries a canonical evidence fingerprint, revalidates on decode and contains no filesystem path, object path, bucket, URL, bearer token or raw bytes.

AttachmentCaptureStoring is the narrow backend-neutral enqueue boundary; AttachmentCaptureReceiptFailure exposes closed stable validation, scope, byte-evidence, fingerprint and malformed-encoding codes.

postgresSchema.notApplicable: This Phase 1 receipt boundary creates no attachment/reference table, object locator, constraint, index, view or migration.

serverHandlers.notApplicable: No upload, attach-to-parent, retry, verification, derivative, reorder, primary, detach, delete, cleanup or reconciliation handler exists.

dataApiGrants.notApplicable: No relation, view, function or object endpoint is exposed through Supabase.

rlsPolicies.notApplicable: Exact local scope matching is not server authorization. No membership predicate, Storage policy, grant or RLS policy exists in this slice.

syncStreams.notApplicable: No PowerSync Stream, local table, upload connector or readiness claim is defined. The receipt proves only the structured evidence contract future local media metadata must preserve.

items: The receipt is canonical Codable evidence over environment, Principal, Account, parent, Attachment, opaque local object, byte count, checksum and time; decode reconstructs through the same validators and byte-identical restart is required.
Cross-environment/Principal/Account/parent/Attachment evidence, changed byte count/checksum, invalid time, malformed identity and changed fingerprint fail atomically without returning a receipt.
The narrow port permits a deterministic failure adapter to return an error with no success-shaped receipt; actual protected local persistence and physical restart remain unimplemented and unclaimed.
Raw capture bytes are nonempty, hashable input only and cannot enter the encoded receipt; the receipt matches an adapter-reported opaque protected-local object by exact size and SHA-256.

No path/URL/bucket/provider value, upload/verification/derivative behavior, cache cleanup, reference removal or physical deletion is present; O-023 and the allowed content/size/derivative policies remain open.

Deterministic media-fault tests prove no false-success receipt on a simulated local-store failure while explicitly deferring encryption, disk-full, interruption, process/device restart and private remote rendering to SPIKE-MED-001.

appMcp.notApplicable: No current capture screen, gallery, parent model, MCP tool/schema, UI state or transport adapter is wired.

migrationReconciliation.notApplicable: No Firebase AttachmentRef, URL/path, pending-upload file, Storage object or export is decoded/transformed. Later import must correlate bytes and references rather than manufacture this receipt from URL metadata.

observabilityRunbooks.notApplicable: Stable bounded failures are contract values only; no metric, upload age, disk pressure alert, cleanup action or runbook execution is introduced.

items: Implementation remains inside provider-free LedgerTargetCore and its tests and does not modify either application project or the Firebase checkout.
The slice cannot claim actual protected persistence, accept a user capture in the app, upload/render media, mutate parent references, deploy, migrate, release or cut over.
A-003/A-004/A-016, SPIKE-MED-001, O-022/O-023, production reference/object profiling and content/size/derivative policy remain outside this receipt-value boundary.

verification.expected: Matching synthetic capture and persisted-object evidence yields one stable path-free receipt whose Attachment identity is independent of opaque local-object identity and whose structured form excludes raw bytes.
A representative receipt round-trips byte-identically with exact scope, Attachment/local-object identity, byte count, digest, time and fingerprint while carrying no raw bytes or provider locator.
Empty capture, invalid time/identity/digest, cross-scope or changed Attachment/parent/size/checksum evidence, malformed encoding and fingerprint tamper fail atomically with stable bounded codes.

A deterministic failing capture-store adapter returns an error and no receipt while an evidence adapter returns only an exact validated receipt; the test records that it is not physical durability proof.

verification.owner: pull-request CI Isolated target environment job
verification.expected: The exact implementation commit passes conversion traceability, provider/source-contamination and generated-contract checks, the complete target suite, both target builds and clean artifacts without changing an application project or claiming physical media/provider behavior.

notes: Decision-independent Phase 1 attachment receipt/value boundary only. It does not prove actual protected local persistence or any upload/display/provider behavior. O-023 remains fully open because no reference-removal or byte-deletion capability exists.
